alternatives: one all-in-one product
independent horizontal products plus suites
decision: Refuse the monolith: source, policy, table, query, semantics, operations and exit have different authorities and failure domains.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: lakehouse as one product
table semantic contracts/capabilities plus catalog, query, ingestion, managed-maintenance, sharing and experience products
decision: Retain lakehouse as an architecture/suite: table formats are standards and semantic contracts, while independently adopted operated promises may become products.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: one storage architecture product
two experience products over shared table/query/policy capabilities
decision: Retain alternative experiences until adoption, portability and workload SLO evidence supports merge.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: catalog owns all governance
discovery projection separate from glossary, policy, lineage, quality and master data
decision: Refuse concentrated authority and duplicated semantic ownership.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: one semantic-governance owner
business glossary and formal ontology/knowledge-model products
decision: Human term stewardship and formal axiom/inference semantics have different equality, lifecycle, failure and adoption boundaries.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: one schema-and-contract registry
schema registry plus data-contract registry
decision: Syntax and reader-writer compatibility are imported evidence within, but cannot replace, semantic and service acceptance.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: query engine owns metrics
semantic metric service compiles into replaceable query engines
decision: Keep business meaning above physical planning and execution.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: BI tool owns metric definitions
BI imports semantic metric contracts
decision: A presentation channel cannot become the sole business-semantic owner.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: pipeline owns source meaning
source owner publishes contract; pipeline imports through ACL
decision: Movement does not create source authority.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: one generic pipeline product
connectivity, CDC, ingestion, orchestration, dataflow, transform-build, event-streaming and activation products
decision: Split by cursor/state, effect authority, lifecycle, failure, support and exit; retain ETL/ELT/CDC/reverse-ETL labels as patterns.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: one observability product
data fitness and platform telemetry remain independent
decision: A healthy service can return semantically wrong data and a quality failure need not be a platform outage.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: one collaboration feature
sharing and clean-room products with separate release authority
decision: Raw disclosure and aggregate-only computation have materially different trust and exit boundaries.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: one AI/ML platform
model lifecycle + feature platform + inference serving + model assurance + deterministic decisioning + optional extension runtime
decision: Training, temporal feature truth, serving SLOs, evaluation evidence, deterministic decision semantics and optional generated proposals have different owners and exit boundaries.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: one product per analytical method label
methods and libraries imported into job-specific workbenches, engines and vertical applications
decision: A practice such as statistics, anomaly detection, graph analysis or causal inference is not independently a product; adoption, lifecycle, operation, support and exit must be proven separately.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: prefix every analytical capability with AI
deterministic core with prohibited, optional or intent-required model/LLM/agent ports
decision: Automation modality is a typed binding choice, not a domain boundary; assistance never acquires semantic or effect authority.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: product per vendor connector
source connectivity product plus adapter/provider registry
decision: Vendor adapters are replaceable provider implementations, not product semantics.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: product per codec or format
representation libraries and provider offers imported by products
decision: Encoding lacks a direct enterprise outcome and support/exit boundary.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: new horizontal product per industry
industry solution packs compose unchanged horizontal products
decision: Vertical terms, rules and authority stay in packs; horizontal meanings must not branch by industry.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: product per bounded context
products compose contexts through published languages
decision: Semantic ownership and adoption boundaries are orthogonal graphs.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: every table is a data product
only independently valuable governed publications qualify
decision: A table without users, SLO, access, lifecycle and exit remains an asset/output port.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.

alternatives: every chart/widget is a product
rendering capability or module within BI/embedded experiences
decision: A widget has no independent adoption, support, economic or exit promise.
reopen_when: New user/adoption/authority/SLO/exit evidence changes at least two split-test coordinates.
